Dehydrated Mint Leaf Powder for Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Tradenest Naturals manufactures dehydrated mint leaf powder for seasoning blenders, beverage brands and private label businesses. As a bulk dehydrated mint leaf powder supplier, we serve food companies in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. Gentle drying helps the powder keep the green color and cool, fresh aroma of mint leaves. Food production depends on consistent ingredients, so we make every batch to the same written specification. That gives manufacturers a reliable flavor for large-scale recipes. Our mint powder is a simple way to add real herb character to your products.

Advanced Manufacturing Process

First, fresh mint leaves are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Next, the leaves are inspected and washed to remove soil and foreign matter. Then they are dehydrated at controlled temperatures to remove water gently. After drying, the leaves are milled into a fine, even powder. Finally, each batch is sieved and checked for moisture and mesh before packing.

Quality Standards

Quality sits at the center of our work at Tradenest Naturals. We are an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Every lot carries a batch number for traceability. We follow written standard operating procedures (SOP) at each step of production.

Key Applications in the Food Industry

Our mint leaf powder bulk supply is used in many sectors. Food manufacturers add it to snack seasonings, spice blends and chutney mixes. Beverage makers use it in herbal teas, syrups and instant drink premixes. Bakers and confectioners use it in flavored biscuits, sweets and mint chocolates. It also adds a cool, fresh note to marinades, sauces and ready meals. Mint is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and herbal formulations.

Exceptional Buyer Value and Benefits

Choosing Tradenest Naturals as your wholesale mint powder manufacturer has clear commercial benefits. First, the powder has a 24 month shelf life in sealed packs, which cuts spoilage and stock loss. Second, it saves cost by removing the need to clean, sort and grind leaves in your own facility. Third, our steady supply helps keep your production schedule on track. Finally, we offer OEM and private label packing to match your brand.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated mint leaf powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Pricing improves with volume, and custom packing terms depend on your requirements.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials, including stand-up pouches and export-grade bulk bags. The standard grade is dehydrated, 80-100 mesh, with moisture at 7% or below. Stored cool and dry, it keeps for 24 months.

What is the lead time for export orders?

Lead time depends on order volume, packing and destination. Samples are available on request. Contact our sales team for a quote or a sample.
